title: DiffuSyn Bench: Evaluating Vision Language Models on Real-World Complexities with Diffusion Generated Synthetic Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the confusion matrices of Vision-Language Models evaluated on a mixed dataset of AI-generated and human-originated images to identify an alignment-driven reluctance (high False Negative rate) to classify images as AI-generated.

Applying usage and reliability controls, such as standardized evaluation prompts, zero temperature, and majority vote aggregation across multiple runs, to measure and reduce variance and scoring bias when using an LLM to evaluate model responses.
